_note: Stage 0. A1-A2, listen-and-repeat only. Every item carries a gloss per language code (fr es pt it de ru ar ur hi bn id vi zh ja ko); questions the learner HEARS carry q<code>. {trade} / {tradeL} are replaced by the active trade in English and in the gloss language. Fifteen days, three sentences a day.
